description_html: About Citi:   Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.     As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.     Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.    The Team:   The  Startups & Partnerships team  is the forward scout of the  Citi's Head of AI Organization . Our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define Citi's next chapter with Artificial Intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. We don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. We move across every line of business at Citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe-to-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier AI labs in the market. We run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us.    The Opportunity:   As an  AI Engineer  on the Startups & Partnerships team, you will be at the  tip of the spear  for Citi's AI strategy - building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines.  You'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a Tier-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading AI labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. If you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts AI - this is the seat.     What You'll Do Day to Day        Build and ship AI applications  - architect, develop, and deploy production-grade AI-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across Citi's lines of business.       Evaluate emerging AI technology  - run structured proof-of-concepts and sandbox "bake-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (LLMs, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real-world fit.       Prototype at speed  - turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback.       Integrate across the stack  - connect LLMs and agentic systems to enterprise APIs, data pipelines, and lightweight front-end or tooling layers to deliver end-to-end working solutions.       Deliver PoCs into production pathways  - work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment.       Communicate impact  - translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders.      Required Skills       A  full-stack engineer with applied AI/LLM experience  - this is explicitly  not  a data science or ML research role. We need builders, not modelers.      Proven experience  building and shipping AI applications, pipelines, and workflows  in live, production environments - not just notebooks and academic experiments.      Hands-on proficiency with  Large Language Models (LLMs) , prompt engineering, and  agentic frameworks and orchestration tools  (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar).      Strong software engineering fundamentals - comfortable working across the stack, from backend services and API integrations to lightweight front-end or internal tooling layers.      Strong communication and stakeholder management skills - you can work directly with business leaders and clients, not just other engineers.      A track record of learning and adopting new tools and platforms quickly as the AI landscape evolves.      Comfort operating in a large, regulated, global institution while bringing a startup-speed mentality to your work.      Nice-to-Have Skills       Experience working directly with startups, venture teams, or technology scouting functions.      Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or knowledge graph-based retrieval.      Experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) for AI services.      Prior exposure to financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries.      Experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical, senior business audiences.      Education     Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience  Master’s degree preferred      This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. The Role:   This role is ideal for a seasoned .Net full-stack developer passionate about creating sophisticated, end-to-end automation solutions. The position involves designing and building applications, services, and databases that streamline business processes within a complex enterprise environment. Successful candidates will leverage their deep technical expertise in .NET, microservices, and database management to drive projects from conception through to deployment.     Responsibilities      Develop and implement new or revised end-to-end application systems including UIs, data storage solutions, and automated workflows.  Create automated processes that interact with multiple APIs, databases, and application user interfaces.  Develop scalable database solutions, including schemas, stored procedures, and functions.  Analyze complex business and system processes to identify opportunities for improvement and provide evaluations based on industry standards.  Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and users to translate business requirements into technical stories and provide sizing estimates for development tasks.  Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including feasibility studies, design, construction, testing, and implementation.  Manage code promotion, CI/CD pipelines, and all necessary SDLC artifacts to meet compliance and operating standards.  Recommend and implement security measures and ensure all essential procedures are followed, including those related to risk and compliance.  Perform code repository hygiene to ensure developer metrics are met and best practices are maintained.  Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.  Provide user and operational support for applications, participate in UAT, and resolve defects in a timely manner to meet release schedules.  Operate with independence and judgment, managing deadlines and unexpected changes in requirements effectively.      Qualifications       Experience:  5+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development.   Core Technical Skills:  Strong knowledge of frontend and backend technologies, including ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and CSS, with strong proficiency in C#.   Modern UI Frameworks:  Experience with modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or Microsoft Blazor.   Microservices & Architecture:  Demonstrated expertise in developing .NET Core microservices, along with a deep understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns.   Database Development:  Proficiency in database development across relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB) and query languages (e.g., PL/SQL, T-SQL).   API Design & Integration:  Deep knowledge of RESTful API design principles and hands-on systems integration experience.   Test Automation:  Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium).   Python & Generative AI (Preferred):  Experience with Python programming, Agentic AI and/or Generative AI (GenAI) development is an added advantage.   Java & Spring Boot (Preferred):  Java development experience with extensive expertise in building microservices using Spring Boot is a strong plus.   DevOps & CI/CD:  Familiarity with DevOps tools and platforms (e.g., Lightspeed, Harness, Tekton, GitHub) and a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.   Project Delivery:  Demonstrated track record of managing and implementing successful projects, supported by a working knowledge of project management methodologies.   Containerization:  Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., OpenShift, Kubernetes) is preferred.   AI-Assisted Engineering:  Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging modern AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin AI) to accelerate the software development lifecycle across design, implementation, testing, and feature delivery.   AI Fundamentals:  Practical knowledge of AI fundamentals, including prompt engineering and integration with AI models and APIs, is a plus.     Professional Attributes:  Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments, handle shifting priorities, and deliver against evolving deadlines and requirements.      Education     Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience.    This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed.
